<documents>
<document id="fee-refunds">
Asking for a fee refund
Support can refund some fees. There are two kinds of refund.

## Fees charged in error

If we charged a fee your plan doesn't have, or charged the same fee twice, we refund it. There's no limit on these refunds and they don't count toward anything else.

## Goodwill refunds

Once in any rolling 12-month period, support can refund one fee of up to $25.00 as a courtesy, even if it was charged correctly. That covers ATM fees, foreign transaction fees, card replacement and expedited shipping fees, wire fees and cash deposit fees.

Plan fees aren't eligible for goodwill refunds. They have their own cooling-off rule instead.

## What support can't do

Support can't refund a second fee as goodwill within 12 months, can't refund a single fee above $25.00 as goodwill, and can't make exceptions to these rules. If you think a fee was charged in error, tell us why and we'll check.

## How to ask

Open the fee in your activity feed, tap Get help, and choose Question about a fee. Refunds show up in your balance right away.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
Charged twice for the same thing
Seeing the same charge twice doesn't always mean you were charged twice.

## Check if one is pending

Hotels, gas stations, car rentals and restaurants often place a temporary authorization, then post the final amount separately. The pending one usually drops off within 7 days. Pending transactions can't be disputed.

## If both have posted

If two identical charges have both posted, contact the merchant first. Most will refund a duplicate quickly. If the merchant doesn't help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Charged twice.

## Duplicate fees

If we charged you the same fee twice, message support. A fee charged in error is always refunded.

## Time limit

Duplicate charges follow the merchant dispute window: 120 days from the transaction date.

## Split payments

Some merchants split one order into several charges, for example when items ship separately. Check your order confirmation before you dispute.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
Plus plan fee schedule
Here is every fee that can apply to a Plus account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $5.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $2.50 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $3.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 1% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $15.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | $35.00 |
| Incoming international wire | $10.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $3.00 |

## Details

Your first 3 out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month are free. The fee applies from the next one.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can support refund my monthly Plus fee as a one time courtesy thing?
